name: wix-studio-cli-monorepo
description: Public monorepo for Wix Studio UI CLI experiments and Wix blog automation tooling.

scripts.check: npm --workspace packages/wix-studio-ui-cli run check && npm --workspace packages/wix-blog-cli run check
scripts.smoke: npm --workspace packages/wix-studio-ui-cli run smoke && npm --workspace packages/wix-blog-cli run smoke
